source: キャラクターが1回の攻撃で与えるダメージ量
translation: The damage you deal with each attack.
review_reason: 1 attack is rendered as each attack; same per-attack quantity.

source: 遠謀#：「聖光柱」を二つ生成
review_reason: Japanese numeral two is rendered as digit 2.

source: カウントX：X秒経過するごとに1回効果を発生させる
translation: Timer X: Activates once every X seconds.

source: 遠謀X：1戦闘中にX回発動、射程が0.2増加するごとに回数は+1される
translation: Tactic X: Activates X times per battle; each +0.2 Range adds 1 activation.
review_reason: 1 battle is rendered as per battle; +0.2 Range and 1 added activation are retained.

source: キル数X：X体の敵を倒すと1回効果が発生する
translation: Kill Count X: Activates once for every X enemies defeated.

source: 跳弾：弾幕が敵に命中した後、さらに前方に1回跳弾し、[攻撃*0.5]のダメージを与える
translation: Ricochet: On hit, bounces forward once for [Attack*0.5] damage.

source: 破甲：1層ごとに目標の受けるダメージが25%増加する、重複可能
translation: Armor Break: Damage taken +25% per stack. Multiple stacks can accumulate.
review_reason: 1 stack is rendered as per stack; 25% retained.

source: 「遠謀」系スキルが#％の確率で2回発生する
translation: Tactic skills have a #% chance to activate twice.

source: 「カウント」系スキルが#％の確率で2回発動する
translation: Timer skills have a #% chance to activate twice.

source: スキル：#秒間、通常攻撃のダメージが2倍になる、クールダウン12秒
translation: Skill: Double normal attack damage for # seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

source: スキル：#回の攻撃の間攻撃速度が2倍、貫通ダメージが+25%される、クールダウン18秒
translation: Skill: # attacks at double speed, +25% Piercing Damage. Cooldown: 18 sec.
